description: The pie chart represents the distribution of domains in the AttrEval-GenSearch test set, which covers a total of 12 different domains. The largest segment is AI/NLP Research, accounting for 24.3% of the test set. The second-largest segment is Economics & Finance with 18.4%. Other notable segments include History at 8.2%, Game & Anime at 8.2%, and Daily Life at 7.1%. The remaining domains are represented with smaller percentages: Pet & Animal at 5.5%, Medicine & Health at 6.7%, Law at 5.1%, Business at 5.9%, Geography at 2.7%, Math at 1.2%, and Science at 6.7%. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are labeled directly on the corresponding slices. The segments are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
